description.value: A permaculture demonstration garden on the Vancouver Island University Nanaimo campus, located on the north side of the campus library. Originally called the Community Peace Garden, the space has been cultivated since 2008 as a place for learning about food growing, seed saving, plant medicine, and traditional ecological knowledge. The garden is designed to be accessible to as many people as possible and visitors are invited to participate.

The website describes it as open and inviting to visitors but provides no information about bike parking, water, or washrooms at the garden itself. All amenity fields remain null due to absence of evidence. The name in OSM ('Community Peace Garden') is the former name; the current name per the website is 'Permaculture Club.'
